claim_boundary.scope: Only M16 and M128 original L0 RMS outputs and complete official L0 QKV weight at pinned revisions; no universal input/backend claim.

domain_interpretation.inference: Observed tiny-only pair differences are consistent with the documented instruction-local underflow behavior. This diagnostic did not emulate flushing or prove a universal native backend equivalence.
domain_interpretation.libm_reference: FE_TONEAREST, FTZ=0, DAZ=0, gradual FP32 underflow and gradual BF16 RNE; tiny boundary tests reject incompatible host environment.
domain_interpretation.native: Actual dumped kernels use VDPBF16PS and VCVTNEPS2BF16. Intel documents instruction-local denormal flushing regardless of MXCSR. A clear MXCSR FTZ/DAZ therefore does not prove native gradual underflow.
